name: Neck Flexion
instructions: Sit tall and place your palm on your forehead.
Gently push your head forward into your hand while resisting with your hand.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: An isometric or light-resisted neck flexion that builds neck endurance.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
safetyNotes: Keep the effort light to moderate; stop with dizziness or pain.
